problem: Native Excel analytics parts exposed case-sensitive slicer-owner GUID matching, unsupported timeline relationship/MIME spellings and MCE directives, dropped sparkline identities, and unrecognized direct table sort states. A full-suite regression also exposed saved sort extents beyond current table bounds.
changes: Match slicer integration GUIDs case-insensitively in reads and both rewrite paths, retaining namespace/ownership checks and duplicate-owner refusals.

Use native 2011/lowercase timeline relationship and content types for new authoring; accept exact documented 2010/capitalized aliases throughout graph validation, including orphan and wrong-owner checks.

Project timeline payload MCE with timeline/revision namespaces understood and opaque extension lists preserved. Check original and projected XML against caller limits; package integration scans keep original offsets.

Recognize direct table sortState. Retain exact, individually bounded saved ranges even when stale relative to current table extents. Authoring remains owner-bounded and accepts native full-column keys outside the selected sort-state rows; no sort is executed.

Preserve sparkline revision2 identities through MCE and standalone fragment writing. Resolve UID namespace aliases to the declared canonical prefix; refuse duplicate identities and unignorable foreign bindings of xr2:uid.
Add seven native analytics tests and targeted compatibility/negative cases; strengthen existing source/eager table assertions for stale sort metadata.

Add per-row verification-gap categories, historical support/evidence references and a --gaps report. Historical fixture evidence and pending classifications are not promoted to passing operations or accepted exclusions.

verification_scope.pivots_tables: Four native XLSX/XLTX/Strict/control variants: exact Table1 columns/ranges/direct sort metadata, all eight decoded PivotCache rows, row/column/page field bindings, Sum aggregation, locations and stored filtered/unfiltered totals.
verification_scope.slicers: Two caches and two views: exact names, source fields, revision GUIDs, table bindings, captions, row heights and column counts. Selected-item indices/flags are asserted in retained XML, not interpreted as executed UI filtering.
verification_scope.timelines: Native graph identity, internal cache ID, DateBetween filter, February 2026 selection, year bounds and Month view level. Documented legacy graph aliases remain readable and cannot bypass ownership checks.
verification_scope.sparklines: Four native variants: both groups, all four series/destinations, types, hidden-data/high/low flags, series colors and native GUIDs survive fragment serialization. Alias/MCE regression and foreign/duplicate negatives are separate synthetic cases.
verification_scope.conditional_formatting: All eight core rules plus the x14 data-bar enhancement: exact ranges/priorities/types, source-order priorities, DXF/formula references, thresholds/colors/icon settings and GUID association.
verification_scope.edits: Slicer and timeline caption edits plus slicer-cache reordering reopen to the expected typed models; unrelated member payloads and retained-owner inverses are byte exact. Filter application returns its explicit typed Unsupported error.
verification_scope.table_compatibility: The existing ConditionalFormattingSamples.xlsx retains Table1 sort A3:E24/key A2:A24 and Table3 sort A2:G22/key A1:A22 through both source and eager readers despite their current A3:E25/A2:F21 table bounds. Invalid/out-of-sheet ranges and duplicate owners still fail; authoring rejects outside-owner keys.
verification_scope.provenance: Tracked fixture bytes are unchanged. No new upstream fixtures, executables or large evidence are committed. No Office UI/reopen, calculation, rendering, refresh, macros or external connections were executed.
